chunks: Yūnus, from ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥalabī, from a man, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله sent ʿAlī عليه السلام to Yemen. A horse belonging to a man from the people of Yemen got loose and ran by; it passed by a man and struck him with its leg, killing him. The heirs of the slain man came to the horse’s owner, seized him, and brought him to ʿAlī عليه السلام. The owner of the horse produced evidence that his horse had escaped from his house and struck the man, so he عليه السلام declared the blood of their companion without liability.

He said: The heirs of the slain man came from Yemen to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and said: O Messenger of Allah, indeed ʿAlī has wronged us and nullified the blood of our companion. So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام is not one who wrongs, and he was not created for ظلم, because the wilayah belongs to ʿAlī after me, and the judgment is his judgment, and the word is his word. None rejects his wilayah, his word, and his judgment except a disbeliever, and none is pleased with his wilayah, his word, and his judgment except a believer.

So when the Yemenis heard the statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله concerning ʿAlī عليه السلام, they said: O Messenger of Allah, we are satisfied with the judgment of ʿAlī and his word. Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: And that is your repentance from what you said.

key_terms.الْبَيِّنَةَ: legal proof or evidence produced before judgment
key_terms.الْحُكْمَ: the binding legal judgment or ruling exercised by Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةَ: authority and guardianship belonging to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.تَوْبَتُكُمْ: your repentance from the wrongful statement you made
key_terms.دَمَ: the blood-liability or claim arising from a killing

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the Prophet’s affirmation of Imam ʿAlī’s عليه السلام judgment and authority after him?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a legal case judged by Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in Yemen regarding a death caused by a runaway horse, after which the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله affirmed the correctness of his ruling. It also emphasizes the wilayah, authority, and judgment of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, presenting acceptance of his authority as a mark of faith.
